desc: 晴空蓝黄童趣天空风，双色翻领polo，徽章与螺纹细节，户外场景收口
name: 男童徽章双色polo衫款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的童装白底主图
用晴空涂鸦氛围一秒传达夏日童趣穿着主张
并排展示两个配色，让买家按喜好选择
让家长代入孩子夏日户外玩耍的真实穿着场景
用翻领、徽章位、螺纹袖口与下摆微距证明做工细节
以晴空主色与空白优惠位收口促单

style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF packshots, sky blue #AEDCF0 campaign panels, warm cream #FDF6EC outdoor scenes, pale sky-blue matte board #E8F4FB detail boards
style.iconSystem: flat doodle icons (clouds, paper plane, gift box) in a single accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight-style studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful kids summer fashion visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud white #FFFFFF, sky blue #AEDCF0, sunny yellow #F5C542 and deep-sea blue text #2E5E8C; bright soft daylight-style lighting with a front-left key and gentle contact shadows; rounded friendly geometric sans-serif with bold brush-style headline accents; flat doodle icons in one accent color; clean garment photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the garment, consistent scale across colorways and scenes
style.surfaceSystem: matte white board and smooth sky-blue paper backdrop
style.typography: rounded friendly geometric sans-serif with bold brush-style headline accents in deep-sea blue #2E5E8C
